profileLabel: Mildly left economics; offsetting on institutions (low confidence)
summary: Pampanga 1st District representative with 151 principal-authored bills. Authored criminal penalties for occupational safety and health violations, tax relief on overtime and night differential, tax incentives for pro bono physicians, tax deductions for parents of special needs children, an anti-dynasty ban, a postponement of the November 2026 barangay and SK elections and a bill fixing their terms. Co-authored the national minimum wage.
caveat: Postponement bills were widely co-sponsored. Economic score nets labor protections against tax incentives.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored criminal penalties for occupational safety violations (-2) and co-authored the national minimum wage (-2), with tax items near neutral: overtime exclusion and special-needs deductions (-1), physician incentives (+1).
